title: B.E.R.T.
description: Allows you to bypass Minecraft's 64 block hardcoded banner rendering limit.
body:
**Banner Extended Rendering Tool (B.E.R.T.)**
Allows you to bypass Minecraft's 64 block hardcoded banner rendering limit.
**How to set up:**
1. Go into the mod menu.
2. Find B.E.R.T.
3. Click on the Config button.
4. Adjust the slider. (slider is in blocks, not chunks)
5. Click Done.
6. Get back in the game.
